faq.question: Will I lose access to Seller Central?
faq.answer: No. You retain full ownership. We work through authorized user access with clear reporting.

faq.question: What tasks do you take on day to day?
faq.answer: Scope is defined in onboarding. Typical work includes cases, listing ops tasks, promotions coordination, and other agreed Seller Central follow-ups.

faq.question: Is this the same as full-service management?
faq.answer: Seller Central services can run as a focused ops engagement or as part of full-service account management that also owns PPC and listing strategy.

faq.question: Which marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com.
